native_plugin.scenario: Synthetic prior release to current release using native Git marketplace

skills: All three Skills passed official quick_validate.py; Chinese display metadata passed YAML parsing and length checks
first_use: Read-only preview leaves settings and ignores untouched
First development initializes the current Git repository through project_prepare
Repeated preparation preserves settings and developer edits
Invalid roots, unsafe state and malformed settings do not initialize
Concurrent initializers cannot overwrite the winner
Standalone packaged MCP initializes and recovers tasks after restart
limitations: Desktop entry appearance and background auto-update interval were not visually tested
Default initial scope is one repository; a different or broader workspace remains an explicit settings change
A real productivity benefit still requires colleague trials
